subject: AWS Marketplace: contract window, pricing bands, and procurement acceptance
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwave.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: James O'Connor <james.oconnor@brightwave.com>, procurement@brightwave.com
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace engagement — term and pricing clarifications

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick demo earlier this week. Procurement asked me to send the procurement team’s requirements so you can confirm whether the deal can be packaged via AWS Marketplace and the approval path that BrightWave needs to follow. High-level asks:

- Target start/activation window: July 1 start, 1-year initial term; open to 12 or 24 month pricing buckets.
- Desired price structure: list + tiered discount for committed usage (we expect ~$180k first-year usage).
- Need to understand whether Marketplace Private Offer can support proration for mid-month activation and whether we can lock unit pricing for the full term.
- Security/compliance checklist is already submitted through your portal; procurement will request a finalized SOW and invoice cadence before signing.

Please include any gating (CFO signoff thresholds, buyer-approval lanes) so we can map internal approvers. We’d like to close by mid-May to align with budget planning.

Attachments: BrightWave_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW draft), pricing_matrix.xlsx (their internal forecast).

Best,
Sara Liu
VP, Cloud Platforms
BrightWave Corp

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwave.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace engagement — term and pricing clarifications

Sara — thanks for sending the docs and the clear timeline. Short answer: yes, we can route this as an AWS Marketplace private offer and support the term/pricing structure you described, with a couple of implementation notes. Summary and next steps below.

Summary of what we can offer via AWS private offer:
- Term options: 12-month and 24-month options available; pricing bands are supported at the offer level (we’ll publish two offer SKUs to reflect the 12/24 mo price bands).
- Proration: Marketplace invoices can be prorated for mid-cycle activation, but this requires the PO to reference the Marketplace offer activation date — we can include proration instructions in the private offer.
- Price-lock: we can lock unit pricing for the selected term; early termination clauses would be handled in the SOW (standard).
- CFO/buyer approvals: internal gating we commonly see — purchase orders under $50k route through procurement only; >$50k requires CFO or delegated signatory. Since you expect ~$180k, CFO approval will likely be required on your side.

Operational asks from us to BrightWave procurement:
1) Confirm which term you prefer (12 vs 24) and which legal entity will sign the Marketplace PO.
2) Provide final billing contact and legal signatory name (we’ll pre-fill DocuSign).
3) Confirm whether you want monthly or quarterly invoicing cadence on the Marketplace invoice.

Proposed timeline to meet your mid-May close target:
- Today: confirm term and signatory (BrightWave) — reply in-thread.
- Mon 5/7: Redwood will draft the private offer and prepare DocuSign link.
- Wed 5/9: BrightWave procurement to route internally (CFO approval window).
- Fri 5/12: Expected DocuSign counter-signature and Marketplace activation.

I’m attaching a short checklist for your procurement team; I’ll also loop in our Marketplace ops contact if you want to accelerate the DocuSign step.

Attachment references: we’ve received BrightWave_SOW_v2.pdf and pricing_matrix.xlsx.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Marketplace Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 14:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace engagement — term and pricing clarifications

Quick note — tagging the finance/discounting policy:
- For expected ARR <$250k we can typically approve list-discounting up to 18% as a seller-managed concession. Anything above that requires revenue ops and finance sign-off.
- For deals with a customer CFO approval step, allow 48–72 hours buffer for treasury/legal signoff on the buyer side.

Olga — if BrightWave prefers 24 months and asks for a deeper band, I recommend we prepare an alternate price band and route it through Revenue Ops before sending to DocuSign.

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

From: BrightWave Procurement <procurement@brightwave.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightwave.com>, James O'Connor <james.oconnor@brightwave.com>
Date: Sat, 5 May 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace engagement — term and pricing clarifications

Olga,

Thanks — BrightWave confirms the following:
- We will proceed with a 12-month term (start target July 1).
- Billing: monthly invoicing preferred.
- Legal signatory: James O'Connor, CFO (james.oconnor@brightwave.com).
- We request a 15% discount tier for committed usage and a proration clause for mid-month activation.

Please send the DocuSign envelope with the Marketplace private offer and pre-filled SOW. If you can flag this as requiring CFO countersignature, we'll route immediately — aim for DocuSign by EOD Monday.

Regards,
BrightWave Procurement Team
procurement@brightwave.com
